assertions.message: Suzanne2 remains the exact 40x40 authored grid
# / Z / z author exactly 313 wall cubes
effect walls bring the collision-cube total to 315
all fifteen authored rings render initially
three source chains preserve nine rigid parts
three pistons preserve bar, plate, and trigger semantics
both effect cells preserve four 64-particle emitters
finish and halfway gates preserve four posts and two segments
two CubX anchors remain explicit but hidden by default
all three Suzanne2.xml objects render
the @ spawn preserves its non-centered [10,0.5,6] loader position
active-source SuperCage / FireArrow player dimensions survive
finish endpoints match the ASCII F/f cells
halfway endpoints match the ASCII H/h cells
QA preserves the authored 15 versus implemented 2 progression conflict
no invented lap victory target is attached to Suzanne2
isolated candidate excludes host globals and labels the missing screenshot boundary
deterministic one-second advance applies the source 100-degrees-per-second ring rotation
ring pickup visibility API removes one authored ring without mutating inventory
piston API reaches the exact +0.5 sliding limit
CubX evidence anchors can be inspected independently
XML and player layers are independently isolatable
implemented source camera pose is directly inspectable
reset restores every source layer
Suzanne2 preview has no browser console or page errors

initial.title: Suzanne 2 — isolated ASCII environment
initial.evidenceBoundary: No Suzanne2 screenshot survives in the audited archive. The candidate therefore follows the active March 2017 GamePlayScreen + GraphysX_1 BuildASCIIScene branch and does not borrow Suzanne1.png presentation inferences.
unresolved: No Suzanne2 screenshot was found, so exact historic camera framing, sky, exposure, and composite appearance cannot be image-matched.
C cells call createCubX and place actors at y=5.5, but the exact actor animation/menu state is outside the ASCII/XML evidence; the preview exposes anchors only.
BonedGate.x contains a 200-tick, 24-ticks-per-second animation for Armature, Armature_Bone, and GateBlock, but the active XML path loads it as a mesh and does not establish animation playback.
The source particle system preserves capacities/colors/settings but not a deterministic seed; preview particle locations are explicitly deterministic visualization, not recovered trajectories.
The active source advances after two ring pickups even though fifteen rings are authored. Both facts are preserved instead of silently inventing a corrected win rule.
